checkpoint.summary: V1 is NOT YET QUALIFIED but the real production pipeline is now MACHINE-QUALIFIED on this machine. Findings A/E wired and proven end-to-end via a real assembled-controller test (Q.WIN.1) on Windows and Q.WIN.WSL.1 through a REAL wsl.exe -d Ubuntu executor with a Linux working tree (C). The loop maps ceiling/wall-clock/exit correctly (G), Sol alone is authoritative via control markers (H), Pause/Resume/Stop/Emergency-Kill semantics are implemented (I), startup rehydration resumes existing runs without duplication (M), problem states are no longer hidden as IDLE (N), Tailscale reports honest status (P: not_installed on this box, never falsely 'configured'), and log events are secret-redacted at the bus (O). Playwright driver is self-contained and omits forbidden flags (K); browser profile ownership is implemented (J). Kimi/Codex invocation profiles exist (D) but are SIMULATION-TESTED / UNQUALIFIED here (no real CLI auth burn). ChatGPT wake (L) and headed setup (K) are SIMULATION-TESTED via mock driver; real Chromium/ChatGPT/Tailscale qualification remains UNQUALIFIED/MANUALLY-QUALIFIED on this machine. Simulation tests remain as regression coverage but are NOT proof of real autonomy.

blockers.summary: Prior V1_ROADMAP_COMPLETE claim is unsubstantiated: production pipeline was not actually wired and ceiling/exit were mapped to GOAL_COMPLETE. Real end-to-end autonomy has not been demonstrated on this machine.
blockers.evidence: apps/controller/src/app.ts wires WatcherService without a loop callback; LoopService takes watcherService but never stores/calls it; ExecutorService.onExit updates dispatchStore but never calls loopService.onExecutorCompleted; loop-service.onExecutorCompleted maps ceiling/wall-clock/exit to GOAL_COMPLETE; StartupReconciler calls startRun() on already-active runs; RunStore.getActiveRun excludes problem states.
